# BhagyaKar

> BhagyaKar is an online Vedic palm reading service. Customers upload a photo of their right palm along with their name, date of birth and gender, select the life areas they're curious about, and receive a personalised reading covering career, marriage, health, finance, relationships and more, delivered by email. Available at bhagyakar.com and as an Android app.

## Reading styles
- Classical Reading (₹999): Traditional Vedic palmistry combined with traditional Vedic timing calculations based on date of birth.
- Ancient Texts (₹1199): Draws on a wider base of historical palmistry knowledge spanning Indian and Western traditions.
- Compare Both (₹1499): Runs both analyses and shows where they agree and differ.
- Returning customers get a discounted follow-up/progress reading using the same email address.
- After receiving a reading, customers can book a personal consultation with our Jyotishi for an additional fee.

## Key facts
- No birth time or birth place is required, only date of birth.
- The right hand is used, as it is traditionally read as reflecting the life a person is actively shaping through their own choices.
- Readings are for guidance and entertainment purposes; gemstone suggestions are not professional medical, legal or financial advice.
